experiment_data.hypothesis: Detect-and-remove baseline: hard-filter q>0.5 samples then train uniformly on remaining data. Answers reviewer question "why not just filter instead of reweight?" Expected to underperform adaptive weighting due to information loss from discarded samples.
experiment_data.notes: 完成时 conclusion 指引: b=0 throughout; adaptive degenerates to uniform post-filtering. detect-and-remove alone sufficient — adaptive adds no value on already-clean data. 写论文时注意: filtered subset (~153K) 训练 200M tokens 重复 ~2.4x，而 adaptive 用全部 ~371K 只过 1 遍，effective epoch 不同需在 experiment section 说明。

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && WANDB_MODE=disabled python training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data_filtered_q05.jsonl --output_dir output/models/detect_remove_baseline_seed42 --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --weighting_method uniform --contamination_ratio 0.4 --num_train_tokens 200000000 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --learning_rate 5e-5 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --save_steps 500 --logging_steps 10 --bf16 --save_total_limit 3 --save_only_model"
